problem: Steady flow from a reservoir through a single horizontal pipe; Darcy–Weisbach friction with the friction factor from Colebrook–White.
output: Piezometric head h at x = 0 and x = L (and any interior points the solver reports), each row tagged with x.
notes: Re = 3.0e5 and relative roughness 5.0e-4: fully turbulent. Explicit friction formulas (Swamee–Jain, Haaland) agree with Colebrook–White to about 1 % in this range.
